caveats: the ML estimator fits the AMPLITUDE of the velocity field with the fiducial P(k) SHAPE fixed; f sigma_8 = f sigma_8_fid sqrt(A) is the standard velocity-amplitude growth-rate measurement; f_sigma8_ml is shape-corrected to the standard linear sigma_v (pk_corr = (370/sigma_v_EH98)^2), f_sigma8_ml_raw_eh98 is the uncorrected EH98-no-wiggle-tied value (the ~15%% sigma_v deficit inflates the raw amplitude, exactly as in the MV lane)

the injection Monte Carlo (80 realisations of a fiducial-amplitude field + the real cell noise) recovers the amplitude UNBIASED (mean A=1.02, pull 1.4 sigma) and its scatter is the true statistical error -- it matches the Fisher error, confirming the Fisher error is correct; the delete-one-octant jackknife is LARGER and is a conservative geometry-robustness cross-check (octant deletion over-perturbs the large-scale field)

the velocities are binned into HEALPix x radial cells (the same representation as the MV bulk flow) so the constraint is the LARGE-scale field amplitude; single-realization cosmic variance is in the likelihood but the low-order (bulk-flow) modes are poorly constrained by one sky

the DIRECT Vpds is noise-limited -- its ML amplitude RAILS to the prior bound (unphysical outliers to +/-24000 km/s dominate the variance), as the rev-r196 diagnostic already found; f sigma_8 is not reliably measurable from Vpds, so Vpec (the WF-ramp column) is the clean measurement here (more model-dependent, but usable)
claim: precision upgrade: the CF4 velocity-field maximum-likelihood f sigma_8 = 0.40 +/- 0.02 (Vpec, shape-corrected; conservative jackknife +/- 0.10), consistent with the published CF4 ~0.38 and Planck ~0.44; the noise- and correlation-aware ML (injection-MC-validated unbiased, pull 1.4 sigma) replaces the rev-r196 treatment-dependent pair-correlation diagnostic; the direct Vpds is noise-limited (amplitude rails)
estimator: field-level maximum-likelihood f sigma_8 (Johnson+2014): Gaussian likelihood of the cell velocities with covariance C(A) = A G + N, G the fiducial linear velocity covariance, N the per-cell noise; noise- and correlation-aware, the precision upgrade of the rev-r196 pair-correlation diagnostic
product: Cosmicflows-4 groups (Tully+ 2023); ML velocity-field f sigma_8
